entries.zh: 愉悦、兴味（西语 gusto：滋味、乐趣；词头残损，存疑）
entries.en: taste, pleasure, liking (Sp. gusto; headword defective)
entries.notes: L 仅存「gvst」（疑为 gusto），H「訢」与 M「grüān」均标疑，R 栏残缺，义项难定。

entries.zh: 穿孔、打洞；针孔（加圈，义近重出）
entries.en: to pierce a hole; the hole of a needle (for threading)

entries.zh: 闭着的眼睛；眼皮放松闭合
entries.en: closed eyes; eyes with lids relaxed shut

entries.zh: 闭眼、合着的眼睛（加圈重出）
双目低垂收敛、神情谦抑（「mortificados y compuestos」）
entries.en: downcast and composed eyes; mortified, modestly lowered eyes

entries.zh: 眼皮下垂、双目低垂（上一义之异写）
双目暴突（语气更重之说，加圈并划线）
翻白眼、眼白上翻（如临终之状）
entries.en: eyes turned up showing the whites (as at death)
entries.notes: L 栏中部残缺（「como … muere」），据 H/M 定夺为临终翻白眼之状。

entries.en: eyes weary from looking; eyes tired of seeing

entries.zh: 睡眼难睁、眼睛涩重睁不开
entries.en: sleepy eyes that cannot be opened; eyes heavy with sleep
open eyes; to open ( pry open) the eyes
blurred eyes; dim vision, unable to see clearly

entries.notes: M 有 T99 污损难辨；H「首不見」疑为「看不見」之误读（M cuâ m̃ kìnn 正合「看不着」）。

entries.en: the look in the eyes; expression of the eyes
entries.notes: L 西语词头原件空缺，仅据 H「眼彩」与 M「gien chay」定夺。
H、M 两栏皆空，仅 L 重出上一行词目（加圈），无以为释。

entries.zh: 老眼昏花、年老视物模糊
entries.en: dim-sighted with age; blurred vision of the old
